question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2. **
solution:
The correct option is: **Organise**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Organise",** fits perfectly here because it's in future simple tense ("will organise"), indicating a future action the universities and colleges are to perform. 
 
• Also,** 'organise' **works well with the auxiliary verb 'will', building a coherent future tense structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Organising**" is a present participle form, which is not appropriate in this context.
 
• "**Have managed**" is a past participle form, which is also not appropriate in this context.
 
• "**Managing**" is a present participle form, which is not appropriate in this context.
